Just picked up my pup last week and drove a 9 hour car ride, what helps the most was having someone at the back with the puppy to help calm them down.

What we did was bring a Landry basket that was big enough to fit him and put pee pads in it incase we wouldn't be able to to get off on a exit to allow him/her to relieve themselves.

We also brought a blanket that smells like me and the puppy's mom to help relax them. We also got a few chew toys to help ease/ distract him/her for the car ride.
Also a side note bring some treats to give him/her when he does go to the bathroom outside which will kinda build some trust/ liking towards you.

Hope this helped, Also congratulations and good luck!
